subject: Q1 Field Day — pipeline credit audit and post-event ROI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudlytics.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q1 Field Day — pipeline credit audit and post-event ROI

Hi Sonia —

Thanks again for partnering with us at the Redwood Field Day last week. We ran an initial post-event rollup and identified $435k of influenced pipeline across three opportunities that our SDRs flagged as Field Day sourced. I attached the export (FieldDay_Pipeline_Q1.csv) and a copy of the promotional SOV we had on file (SOV_FieldDay_Promo.pdf).

A few specific asks:
- Can you confirm whether Cloudlytics wants full credit on the two deals that had booth engagements (listed as CLD-001 & CLD-002 in the CSV)?
- If there are any internal notes or procurement POs that show Cloudlytics led the conversion, please attach — that helps us reconcile credit in HubSpot.

We're trying to finalize the ROI deck and pipeline attribution by EOD Thursday so marketing can close this quarterly report. If you prefer, we can set a 20-min sync tomorrow.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FieldDay_Pipeline_Q1.csv, SOV_FieldDay_Promo.pdf
From: Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudlytics.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 11:05:13 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q1 Field Day — pipeline credit audit and post-event ROI

Ben —

Appreciate the summary. Quick note — Cloudlytics ran our own outreach at the booth and directly booked two vendor evaluation meetings that led to CLD-001 and CLD-002. We have email chains and a PO for CLD-002 from procurement@cloudlytics.ai (attached screenshot). From our perspective, those two should be credited to Cloudlytics at 60% (referral + co-sell) given we introduced the evaluation.

We're happy to split influenced credit for the other opportunity you listed. Before we agree to finalize the ROI deck, can you share how Redwood is defining 'Field Day sourced' (first-touch vs multi-touch)? The CSV doesn't show our campaign UTM tags for CLD-001/002.

Sonia Patel
Head of Partnerships, Cloudlytics
sonia@cloudlytics.ai

Attachment: email_screenshot.png
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q1 Field Day — pipeline credit audit and post-event ROI

Team —

Quick internal recap based on Ben's export and Sonia's reply:
- Field Day tracking: we primarily used badge-scan leads + the event UTM campaign (utm_campaign=redwood_field_day_q1).
- Partner co-sells were supposed to be recorded with the "partner_referral" lead tag; if Cloudlytics recorded separate outreach, that should have been captured in their tag.

Dev — can you reconcile badge scan IDs to the lead records Ben pulled and confirm whether CLD-001 / CLD-002 have partner_referral set? If partner_referral is present we can consider a co-credit. If not, we should confirm with Cloudlytics where the lead came from.

Proposed compromise to keep the ROI close: offer 50/50 influenced credit on CLD-001/002 pending final doc evidence from Cloudlytics. That keeps the deck moving and gives us leverage if they provide clear first-touch proof.

I'll prepare a 1-slide appendix for the ROI deck that explains the rationale and the outstanding data items.

-Marissa
VP, Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 13:10:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q1 Field Day — pipeline credit audit and post-event ROI

Folks —

I pulled the records this morning and attached a cleaned export (see FieldDay_Pipeline_Q1.csv). Findings:
- CLD-001: lead created 2026-03-10 via manual entry (badge scancode #BX-233). No partner_referral flag. No UTM present.
- CLD-002: lead created 2026-03-11 via web-form (source=direct), but the contact notes reference a Cloudlytics rep ("met at Redwood Field Day, followed up"). No partner_referral flag.
- CLD-003: clear Field Day origin (UTM and badge scan), counts as full Redwood-sourced influence.

Attribution policy we use for the ROI deck: multi-touch influenced credit with weightings — badge scan = 0.5 influence, partner referral = 0.6, web-form direct = 0.2. That said, we don't have the partner_referral metadata set on CLD-001/002. Without Cloudlytics providing their outreach evidence (email/PO), the system will mark these as mixed origin.

Operational next steps I recommend:
1) Accept a provisional 50/50 influence split for CLD-001/002 and record a manual revenue split in HubSpot (create revenue split note and tag both Redwood & Cloudlytics).
2) If Cloudlytics provides incontrovertible first-touch evidence within 10 business days, we will re-run the attribution and adjust records (retro credit).
3) For the ROI deck, include a short appendix explaining the provisional split and links to the CSV and SOV.

Link to analysis doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2BFieldDayROI

-Dev (RevOps)

Attachments: FieldDay_Pipeline_Q1.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudlytics.ai>, procurement@cloudlytics.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q1 Field Day — pipeline credit audit and post-event ROI

Sonia / Cloudlytics procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the screenshot, Sonia. Per Dev's analysis and Marissa's recommendation, Redwood will provisionally split influenced credit on CLD-001 and CLD-002 50/50 between Redwood and Cloudlytics pending any additional documentation you can share.

Next steps to finalize:
- Cloudlytics to provide any meeting invites, outreach emails, or PO evidence for CLD-001/002 within 10 business days (send to procurement@cloudlytics.ai and CC me).
- Once we receive those docs, Dev will re-run attribution and update HubSpot.
- I'll circulate the final ROI appendix slide and the full post-event deck to both teams by Friday EOD.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to closing this cleanly.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147
